title: Minimizing Racial Algorithmic Bias when Predicting Electronic Health Record Data Completeness
details: P Anand, Y Jin, J Liu, J Lii, S Belitkar, KJ Lin - Clinical pharmacology and therapeutics
abstract: The previously developed algorithm for identifying subjects with high electronic health record (EHR)-continuity performed suboptimally in racially diverse populations. We aimed to improve the performance by optimizing the race modeling …
